mapper.select: SELECT id, name, description, image_url AS imageUrl, audio_url AS audioUrl, latitude, longitude, radius, updated_by AS updatedBy, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, /* 动态计算当前位置到景点的距离（米） */ ST_Distance_Sphere(location, ST_GeomFromText(CONCAT('POINT(', #{longitude}, ' ', #{latitude}, ')'), 4326)) AS distance FROM scenic_spots /* 核心过滤：计算出的距离必须小于等于景点的感应半径（注意：移除了不存在的 is_deleted） */ WHERE ST_Distance_Sphere(location, ST_GeomFromText(CONCAT('POINT(', #{longitude}, ' ', #{latitude}, ')'), 4326)) <= radius ORDER BY distance ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT s.id AS scenicId, s.name AS name, SUBSTRING(s.description, 1, 30) AS intro, u.phone AS lastModifier, s.updated_at AS modifyTime FROM scenic_spots s LEFT JOIN users u ON s.updated_by = u.id
AND s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC
